crossRefs.note: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?
He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”

who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify for himself a people for his own…

The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having…

And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

translations.web: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”
translations.bsb: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. And this bread, which I will give for the life of the world, is My flesh.”
translations.kjv: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
translations.asv: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: yea and the bread which I will give is my flesh, for the life of the world.
